name: US private residential fixed investment
provider: US Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
includes: New residential structures and manufactured homes
Landlord-owned residential equipment rented to tenants
Brokers commissions and other nonfinancial ownership transfer costs on new and existing residential structures
Net purchases of existing structures from governments
excludes: Principal value of existing-home transfers between private owners
Loan origination and other financial service fees from fixed investment
Residential construction outside the United States
limitations: Gross investment flow, not net of depreciation, not capital stock or mortgage originations
Current revised vintage; not information known during the boom
New investment cannot be divided into services from the entire existing housing stock to infer project payback
Nominal dollar series; movements combine prices and real activity
